channel.title: Al Jazeera - All News
channel.description: Breaking news and analysis from around the world

item.title: Pakistan announces additional troop deployment along western border
item.description: Islamabad said it is deploying more troops along its western border amid rising cross-border militant activity.

item.title: Israel intensifies strikes on Gaza City amid ceasefire talks
item.description: Israeli forces carried out fresh strikes on Gaza City overnight as mediators pushed for a renewed ceasefire agreement.

item.title: Sudan conflict displaces thousands more as fighting spreads
item.description: Aid agencies say fighting in Sudan's Darfur region has forced thousands of additional families to flee their homes.

item.title: Ukraine, Russia trade fresh drone strikes overnight
item.description: Both sides reported intercepting dozens of drones overnight as the war in Ukraine continues into its fifth year.

item.title: Brazil unveils new Amazon deforestation crackdown measures
item.description: Brazil's government announced tighter enforcement measures aimed at curbing illegal deforestation in the Amazon.

item.title: Pakistan, Afghanistan hold talks to ease border tensions
item.description: Officials from both countries met in Doha for talks aimed at de-escalating tensions along the shared border.

item.title: EU leaders meet to discuss new migration policy framework
item.description: European Union leaders gathered in Brussels to negotiate a revised framework for handling migration across the bloc.

item.title: Wildfires force evacuations in southern Europe amid heatwave
item.description: Thousands were evacuated as wildfires spread across parts of southern Europe during an intense summer heatwave.
